verbatim: I was driving home on the 101 around 6pm and this guy just clipped my rear driver side and kept going. I got his plate though, it's on the police report. My tail light is shattered and the bumper's hanging off. I took photos at the scene. The tow truck driver was really helpful, his name was Dave. I just want my car fixed, I need it for work.

My car was stolen from the driveway overnight. I noticed it gone around 7am. I have not filed a police report yet because I am travelling for work and cannot get to the station. I need the payout this week as I have already arranged to buy a replacement vehicle from my cousin's dealership and he is holding it for me. The car had about 40,000 miles on it, everything was perfect, new tires, recently detailed. I can send photos my wife took last month.

Water damage from the storm on August 30th, flooded the whole ground floor. The adjuster who came out said it looked like the damage was mostly from the foundation settling, not the storm, but that was a friend of a friend who does construction, not an official person. I have already paid the remediation company cash, no receipts. My neighbour saw the water, she can confirm. Everything in the living room is destroyed, the TV, the couch, my late mother's piano. I want the full amount, it is all worth that.

A tree limb came through the kitchen window during Tuesday's storm. Glass everywhere and water damaged the counter and floor. I have photos from right after it happened and the tree service invoice. Window guy is coming Thursday. Just need help with the deductible question, everything else is straightforward.
